thread.title: Burgum Says U.S. Natural Resources Could Be 'Triple' the National Debt
thread.title_full: Burgum Says U.S. Natural Resources Could Be 'Triple' the National Debt

author: ACE OF TRUMP
text:
The dollars and cents math of the New Golden Age is beginning to crystalize:
- Increase money in the economy by reducing imports of natural resource materials using U.S. natural resources instead.
- Bring up to a trillion dollars per year back into the US economy by dialing down the trade deficits we have with other countries.
- Put money back in the pockets of Americans by reducing energy costs , to bring down the cost of gasoline, food, and nearly everything else we buy.
- Increase wages by reducing the size of the labor force by deporting illegals and reducing hires of H-1B immigrants.
- Reduce the parasitic cost of production and service delivery by reducing government regulations .
- Bring production back to the US by decreasing business income taxes.
- Increase personal incomes by reducing personal income taxes replacing decreased federal revenue tariff incomes.
- Reduce interest rates and the cost to own homes by reducing the government borrowing that competes with the private sector.
- less significant measures not listed.
